# Primary-source regression fixtures

This directory includes real public issuer/exchange document extracts and bounded PDF/ZIP fixtures used to verify source identity, parsing, arithmetic and rejection behaviour. Their document URLs/hashes are recorded in the fixture metadata and associated tests. Documents retain the rights of their respective issuers/publishers; FINN does not grant a new data/document license.

These test assets are separate from FINN code and dependency licenses. They are not served from the frontend public directory. Before publishing the repository, distributing datasets or deploying public document access, verify the relevant source terms/permissions and, where needed, use authorised or original synthetic test fixtures. A software license, citation or public URL alone does not establish redistribution permission.
